scope: Primary-source verification of the two references supplied in the MEM plan; no project qualification result follows from these papers.

sources.title: Continual Learning Bench: Evaluating Frontier AI Systems in Real-World Stateful Environments
sources.verified_claim: The paper evaluates accumulated-experience gain separately from static capability and reports ICL outperforming the dedicated memory systems evaluated in its benchmark.
sources.scope_boundary: This is a result for that benchmark and evaluated systems, not proof that every memory component is inferior.
sources.name_disambiguation: Distinct from CL-bench: A Benchmark for Context Learning, arXiv:2602.03587.

sources.title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
sources.verified_claim: Ordered fresh-session tasks compare matched retained-experience on/off conditions and report both later-task gains and evidence of the intended save/retrieve/update pathway.
sources.scope_boundary: Pathway evidence and successor performance remain separate project acceptance requirements; a saved artifact alone is insufficient.
